notes: Copy this file to data/cities/<city-id>/layers/jurisdiction_crosswalk.json after replacing the placeholders.
For urban local bodies, match District/PC/AC to ULB wards.
For rural local bodies, match District/PC/AC/Block to gram panchayats or the relevant local unit.
One ward or GP can appear in more than one row when it intersects multiple ACs, PCs, districts, or blocks.
Keep overlap fields numeric so the console can distinguish substantial overlaps from boundary slivers.
